MBA vs PGDM: Which keeps pace with business?

Both build management foundations. The difference lies in how the curriculum can respond to a changing business world.

AreaMBAPGDM

Curriculum

MBAUniversity-led academic framework

PGDMGreater curriculum flexibility within an autonomous management institute

Industry relevance

MBAFollows the framework of the university offering the degree

PGDMCan be refreshed to reflect changing industry practices, technologies and business needs

Learning approach

MBAManagement concepts and academic learning

PGDMGreater emphasis on application, projects and industry exposure

Specialisation

MBASpecialisations vary by university and programme

PGDMFocused specialisations and electives aligned with contemporary business functions

Two years. Two certifications.

Build your management qualification progressively through the two-year Welingkar PGDM, with a certification milestone at the end of each year.

Year01

Advance Diploma in Business Administration

Successfully complete the first year, including the required examinations, viva and project submission, and receive the Advance Diploma in Business Administration in soft-copy format.

Soft copy
Year02

PGDM (Specialization) Hybrid Certification

Complete the second year requirements and receive the PGDM (Specialization) Hybrid certification as a hard copy.

Hard copy
One programme. Two milestones.

Both certifications are awarded upon successful completion of the required examinations, viva and projects.
